faq.question: What are the admission requirements for BBS in USA for Indian Students?
faq.answer: Indian applicants generally require: Class 12 Any Stream, English proficiency (IELTS/TOEFL/PTE or Duolingo), academic transcripts, and letters of recommendation.

faq.question: Can I work while studying in the USA?
faq.answer: International students on F-1 visa can work on-campus up to 20 hours per week during semesters and full-time during breaks. Graduates of STEM programs receive up to 3 years of post-study OPT work authorization.
